_notes: Finetuning starts from hindi/model/checkpoints/checkpoint_step30000.pt (Phase 2 pretrained). Lower learning_rate (1e-4 vs. pretraining's 3e-4) and lighter weight_decay (0.01 vs. 0.1) than pretraining, standard for finetuning an already-trained model. 4,000 train examples / batch_size=32 = 125 steps/epoch; 8 epochs -> 1,000 total steps, reasonable for a small templated synthetic dataset to converge without needing anywhere near pretraining's compute.
